Messages.Body:
Just to be sure: what happens to a Horrid-Reality-summoned stake if the
vampire on the receiving end of it goes to torpor? It is burned, being
chimerical, right?

Thanx
Mathieu

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It is burned or returned the the owner's library as appropriate to
the level at which Horrid Reality was played, correct.
